title: When the representation grows up
description: An empty callback is a good state representation until the system gains named phases and transition behavior worth preserving.

nodes.title: Empty callback
nodes.detail: No work is represented by doing nothing.

nodes.title: Swappable handler
nodes.detail: Replace the current behavior as the work changes.

nodes.title: Named runtime states
nodes.detail: Give the phases names the reader and debugger can see.

nodes.title: Explicit transition timing
nodes.detail: Make enter, exit, queueing, and sequencing part of the contract.
